data.title: Textarea
data.tagline: Let the user enter several lines of text
data.description: Comments, descriptions, feedback, and prompts for AI often need a multiline textarea. Give it a useful starting height and, when needed, a character count or resize control. A normal Input is faster for short, single-line answers.

use: Prompts or notes with several lines
avoid: Use it for a short value that fits on one line
Make a long field so small that writing becomes difficult
Limit the length without showing the limit
Display read-only content inside an editable-looking box

lessonPractice.title: A support form asks people to describe a failure in several paragraphs with a 500-character limit. How should it work?

options.label: Use a textarea and show the remaining character count nearby
options.feedback: The task needs longer free-form text, so multiline space and a visible limit directly support it.

options.label: Use a single-line input that scrolls sideways as text grows
options.feedback: A single line hides context and makes several paragraphs difficult to review and edit.

options.label: Use a rich editor with images, font sizes, and layout controls
options.feedback: The task only needs plain text, so rich formatting tools add unrelated choices and interface weight.

data.agentPrompt: Use a textarea for the failure description, limit it to 500 characters, and show the remaining count live. Test multiple paragraphs, the exact limit, and the over-limit feedback.
